property_summary: For any nonzero input _val, calling SetMinSum(_val) on the correct contract sets MinSum to exactly _val (since initial MinSum starts at 0 and only assignment is used); the mutant multiplies the existing MinSum, so for certain fuzzed _val (e.g. any nonzero) the mutant leaves MinSum at 0 instead of setting to _val, violating the rule.
change_summary: Make SetMinSum multiply the existing MinSum by the provided value instead of assigning (MinSum = MinSum * _val).
